messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth"
set: ["may increase risk of severe bleeding after childbirth", "may increase risk of heavy bleeding after delivery", "could increase risk of excessive bleeding after birth", "drugs that increase risk of bleeding", "may increase risk of eclampsia", "avoid activities that may increase risk of bleeding or injury", "may increase risk of unintended pregnancy", "may increase risk of muscle problems", "increased risk of bleeding", "may increase risk of complications in newborn", "may increase risk of low birth weight", "alcohol may increase risk of liver damage", "taking these products together can increase risk of bleeding", "raise risk of stomach bleeding", "uncontrolled asthma may increase risk of premature birth", "hypothyroidism during pregnancy may increase risk of miscarriage"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
